tasks.title: Implement Dark/Light Mode Theme Support
tasks.description:
Implement theme switching functionality to support both dark and light modes in the calculator application.

Read and modify the following existing files:
- `src/App.tsx` - Add theme state management using React useState/Context
- `src/App.css` - Define CSS variables for light and dark themes
- `src/components/Calculator.tsx` - Add theme toggle button/control
- `src/components/Calculator.css` - Update styles to use theme CSS variables
- `src/components/Display.css` - Update styles to use theme CSS variables
- `src/components/Button.css` - Update styles to use theme CSS variables

Implementation steps:
1. Add theme state in App.tsx (light/dark mode toggle)
2. Create CSS variables in App.css for both themes (background colors, text colors, button colors)
3. Update all component CSS files to use CSS variables instead of hardcoded colors
4. Add a theme toggle button in the Calculator component UI
5. Persist theme preference in localStorage
6. Write tests for theme switching functionality including:
   - Theme toggle button renders correctly
   - Clicking toggle switches between light and dark mode
   - Theme preference is persisted in localStorage
   - CSS variables are applied correctly for each theme
acceptance_criteria: Theme can be toggled between light and dark modes
All calculator components respond to theme changes
Theme preference persists across page reloads
Visual contrast meets accessibility standards in both modes

tasks.title: Validate Theme Switching Tests
tasks.description:
Run the test suite to validate theme switching functionality. Verify all tests pass for:
- Theme toggle component rendering
- Light/dark mode switching
- localStorage persistence
- CSS variable application

Execute: `npx vitest run src/App.test.tsx src/components/Calculator.test.tsx`
acceptance_criteria: No regression in existing calculator tests
Test coverage includes both light and dark mode scenarios
